explanation: From main: script reads of published bundles go through scripts/lib/bundleReader.mts for the query index, expression index, bundle optimizer, upload guards, deploy verifier and SEO study pages, and listDiskCorpus is the one sweep of public/datasets (workflows.md, CONTEXT.md, refactor checklist). From this change: study pages and the agent export read publication identity and per-track counts through scripts/lib/studyRecord.mts, whose meta input on the study pages now comes from the bundle reader. Adding a dataset still needs only its registry entry, bundles and optional studySources.json snapshot.
